calendar.note: Month order inferred from the owner's list order; East and South Lands keep their own calendars. Dates in fields are engine dates at the standard pace.

pace: A date d becomes start + (d - start) x zin_story_pace (1, 1.5 or 0.75), V4 and R2.

beats.name: The peaceful start
beats.historical: On 1 Lumae 4A 1748 the Golden King reigns, Eindil has not appeared, Afrit is unrevealed and no country is at war with anybody who matters.
beats.trigger: Game start (`1748.3.1`). Start check `zin_path.1` (hidden, path module): no war, no contract story flag, `zin_eindil` recruited by nobody, no reachable text naming Afrit (D1, D3 of INTEGRATION_DECISIONS). Dominion and Shadow carry `generate_wargoal_tension = 0.25` (D6).
beats.divergers: The start-variety rule (`zin_rule_start_variety`); any player from the first day (only causes allow war while the Gathering Dark is below 25).

divergences.what: Start variety LIGHT or FULL draws the start values listed under game-start variety.
divergences.consequence: Start values move inside the lore; every beat reads them as variables, so no beat changes owner.
divergences.successor: None needed. `zin_start_variety_drawn` records the draw and the Chronicle names it; variety never counts as divergence.

divergences.what: A player declares a cause war in 1748 or 1749.
divergences.consequence: Peace-breaker spirit `zin_diplo_peace_breaker` for 180 days and +2 Gathering Dark (diplomacy spec); the Grey Ford may break earlier (B05 D2).
divergences.successor: CP01 stays historical (it judges the opening day only); the way code `early_war` is stored for the Chronicle.

divergences.what: A border feud between two minor realms runs at the start (variety V6).
divergences.consequence: A `start_border_war` between tier C realms only; never a great power, never a war.
divergences.successor: Start check accepts border conflicts; the feud ends within 90 days or by `zin_realm.40` terms.

beats.canon: established (Afrit engineers the death); dates and instruments proposed

variables.name: zin_path_cpNN
variables.meaning: checkpoint state: 0 pending, 1 historical, 2 diverged, 3 skipped (06 spec)

variables.name: zin_path_cpNN_way
variables.meaning: which divergence resolved the checkpoint (the divergence index of the beat, for the Chronicle and the endings)

variables.name: zin_path_cpNN_m
variables.meaning: magnitude of the resolution (largest magnitude among the checkpoint's beats)

variables.name: zin_path_points
variables.meaning: sum of weight x magnitude over resolved checkpoints

variables.name: zin_path_resolved_weight
variables.meaning: sum of the weights of resolved checkpoints

variables.name: zin_path_divergence
variables.meaning: how far the resolved story has left history (contract name; read by the AI weights and events_world.mjs)

variables.name: zin_path_departure
variables.meaning: how much of the whole age has been rewritten (fixed denominator; only rises)

variables.name: zin_path_band
variables.meaning: band of zin_path_divergence for text and AI

formula: On each resolution: m = the resolving divergence's magnitude (0 when historical; 0.5 when skipped, because the cause was counted where it happened).
zin_path_points += w x m; zin_path_resolved_weight += w (w from the checkpoint weight table).
zin_path_divergence = 100 x zin_path_points / max(zin_path_resolved_weight, constant:zin_path.floor_weight) with floor_weight 30, clamped 0 to 100: early divergences do not swing the meter to 100.
Bands: 0 to 9 As the Chronicle Tells (0), 10 to 29 Another Telling (1), 30 to 59 A Different Age (2), 60 to 100 An Age Unwritten (3).
uses: Chronicle: `zin_world.110` gains the line `zin_loc_chronicle_divergence` ("Of the age the chroniclers foretold, [?global.zin_path_departure|0] parts in a hundred were written otherwise.") and the band name; the Aoaz bar tooltip shows the band once CP05 has resolved.
AI under PLAUSIBLE: the historical favour (x3, or 75/25 in events) drops to x1.5 (60/40) when `zin_path_divergence` is 50 or more (06 spec; `zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged` already reads it).
AI eras (forces.mjs): `zin_ai_era_stirring` reads CP05 resolved, not the value 0; a band of 2 or more lets tier B AI justify freely from Gathering Dark 35.
Catch-ups: owners' historical fallbacks run only while `zin_path_band` is 0 or 1 under PLAUSIBLE (under HISTORICAL always, under FREE never).
Elves: the Kindred March AI gate needs `zin_path_divergence` 50 or more (B21 D3).
Endings: the proposed outcomes are judged on 1 Glernaen 4A 1762 only when `zin_path_departure` is 15 or more or no canon ending is in reach; otherwise judgement is deferred to 1764 (endings section).
